reason: The subject sounds refactor-only, but the change spans a very broad slice of `pkg/planner/core` plus `pkg/planner/implementation/datasource.go`: plan building, stats, index merge, pruning, explain/stringer, and many optimizer rules. Publicizing logical datasource internals in this area is a central, high-blast-radius planner refactor where unintended semantic regressions are plausible, so it merits a focused Blocker/High review.
